prompt: monitor the battery and land when it drops below 25%
check the wind and move to 0 0 5 if it exceeds 20m/s
check the current altitude and return to base if it is above 100m
check the battery and dock the robot if it is below 15%
check the battery and return to base if it is below 30%
check the battery and announce a warning if it is below 20%
check the wind and land if it exceeds 18m/s
check the wind and return to base if it exceeds 15m/s
check the GPS status and stop if the signal is lost
check the GPS status and localize the robot if the fix is invalid
check the bumper sensors and stop if one is pressed
check the bumper sensors and reverse to -1 0 0 if one is pressed
run diagnostics and stop the robot if a critical fault is found
run diagnostics and record a rosbag if a fault is detected
check the IMU status and land if it becomes unstable
check the IMU status and stop if excessive vibration is detected
check the motor current and stop if it exceeds the safe limit
check the motor current and run diagnostics if it is abnormally high
check the system temperature and stop if it overheats
check the system temperature and announce a warning if it exceeds 80 degrees
check the network status and return to base if communication is lost
check the network status and record a rosbag if packet loss is excessive
check for obstacles and stop if one is too close
check for obstacles and plan a new path if the route is blocked
perform a lidar scan and stop if an obstacle is detected ahead
perform a lidar scan and filter the point cloud if the scan is noisy
detect objects and follow the target if a person is found
detect objects and take a camera snapshot if an unknown object is found
detect objects and announce a warning if a person enters the restricted area
check the costmap and plan a path if the destination is reachable
check the costmap and stop if the robot is inside an occupied cell
check the SLAM status and save the map if mapping is complete
check the SLAM status and localize the robot if tracking is lost
check the odometry and stop if the robot is not moving as commanded
check the odometry and rotate 90 degrees when the robot reaches the waypoint
check the wheel speeds and announce a warning if they differ excessively
check the wheel speeds and run diagnostics if one wheel is not moving
check the current velocity and stop if it exceeds 2m/s
check the current velocity and announce a warning if the robot is moving too fast
check the current position and release the payload if the drone is at the delivery point
check the current position and begin waypoint patrol if the robot is at the starting point
check the camera stream and stop if a person is blocking the path
take a camera snapshot and announce what is visible
load the map and localize the robot within it
check the transform from map to base_link and localize the robot if it is unavailable
dock the robot to charge and undock it when ready to deploy
follow the line and stop when the line ends
explore the frontier and save the map when exploration is complete
start waypoint patrol and return to base when the patrol is complete
set the geofence and take off after it is configured
turn the warning LED on when diagnostics report a fault
announce the obstacle and stop the robot
